comment: M05 alpha gate and M05R review round: real cities on classic RWG, seed 4242 (no oceans, so no monument). Each shot's position and view come from /lostcities find (decision log D115); M05R adds the rise cap's view. M07 adds a cabin and a radio tower; M06 adds the highway, ramp, station and railway shots.
title: Alpha review: real cities on classic RWG, seed 4242

shots.name: above
shots.caption: City from above: the city nearest the spawn, from south of its center, looking north.

shots.name: street
shots.caption: Street level: the primary street nearest the spawn with open street ahead, from head height.

shots.name: interior
shots.caption: Building interior: the ground floor of the building nearest the spawn, looking toward its street door.

shots.name: edge
shots.caption: City edge: where the city meets classic RWG terrain, from just above the land outside it, looking into the city.

shots.name: rise
shots.caption: Rise cap: the city street nearest the spawn beside classic RWG ground at least 12 blocks above it, from above the city looking at the slope. The city stops or steps down here instead of climbing it (AR-4).

shots.name: village
shots.caption: Village sewn into the city: a village's gate where the city's lane meets it, seen from beside the lane, the city on one side and the village on the other. The clearest of every gate within 200 chunks of the spawn (flattest ground, city and village at one height); the nearest village sits on a mountainside.

shots.name: reserved
shots.caption: Reserved lot: the core of the same village as the village shot, the natural ground the city leaves to it, seen from inside the city across the margin.

shots.name: softedge
shots.caption: Soft edge: the city's margin, a chunk of natural ground the blend slopes from the city's edge to a village's ground, with the strip that meets the village's own edge and the lane's steps; the city builds inside it (AR-10, AR-11).

shots.name: scattered
shots.caption: Scattered structure: the cabin nearest the spawn, from the south-east and a little above. The ground under it is leveled and slopes back to RWG's terrain around it, with no cliff and nothing inside it (M07, design record 0009).

shots.name: tower
shots.caption: Scattered structure: the radio tower nearest the spawn, from the south-east and above: level ground under its legs, meeting RWG's terrain without a cliff (M07, 0009).

shots.name: highway
shots.caption: Highway (M06): the straight highway piece above ground nearest the spawn with highway ahead of it, from behind it along its axis, 15 blocks above the deck. Open road in a city, a bridge with railings and supports outside one; the surface is upstream's cyan terracotta.

shots.name: ramp
shots.caption: Highway ramp (M06, AR-10): where a highway climbs or falls a level to reach a city's streets or the ground at a dead end, seen from above the ramp's edge: the deck rises a half block every column or two, with half slabs on the half steps, so it is walked without jumping.

shots.name: station
shots.caption: Railway station (M06): the surface station nearest the spawn, from 30 blocks above it, looking down.

shots.name: railway
shots.caption: Railway (M06): inside the tunnel of the east-west line nearest the spawn, at the track, looking east along the line.
